assess.alertDesc: Rate the capability attributes (PA1.1–PA5.2) of each process per the A-SPICE PAM (N Not achieved / P Partially / L Largely / F Fully). A level is achieved when all PAs of that level are ≥ L, accumulating level by level. Click a process to open the assessment workbench; click an assessment record to view the radar report and gap list.
assess.heatHint: ✓ Achieved · △ One level below · Click a row to assess
assess.emptyRecords: No assessment records yet — click a process in the heatmap above to start
assess.liveResultMet: Live result: achieved CL{{achieved}} ✓ target achieved · PA avg {{avg}}/3
assess.liveResultGap: Live result: achieved CL{{achieved}} (target CL{{target}}{{hint}}) · PA avg {{avg}}/3

PA1.1: Clarify the process purpose and its inputs/outputs; execute base practices per the process definition and keep execution records.

PA2.1: Establish performance management: define process goals, plans and monitoring mechanisms; report execution results regularly.
PA2.2: Manage work products: place them under configuration management with explicit version/review/change/release status.

PA3.1: Define an organization-wide standard process and tailor it to the project, forming a repeatable process definition.
PA3.2: Deploy the process: provide resources/tools/training, collect usage feedback and improve continuously.

PA4.1: Define process measurement indicators and collect data to quantify process performance.
PA4.2: Control the process based on measurement data: identify deviations and take corrective actions.

PA5.1: Identify process improvement opportunities and introduce innovative practices and technologies.
PA5.2: Implement innovation systematically and verify its impact on process objectives.

aiSettings.title: AI Settings
aiSettings.sub: Platform LLM config — shared by EasyFuSa generation & A-SPICE AI builder; falls back to built-in templates when unset
aiSettings.chain: Effective chain: DB config → env vars → built-in templates
aiSettings.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep; stored key is never echoed. For production prefer env AI_API_KEY
aiSettings.note: Security: prefer env vars (AI_API_KEY/AI_BASE_URL/AI_MODEL) for production; DB-stored key is for demo/self-host. AI outputs are drafts requiring engineering review (ASIL is computed by the platform table — AI has no ASIL authority).
aiSettings.gatewaySub: Platform AI now goes through the {{brand}} gateway: EasyFuSa generation and A-SPICE AI builder share one egress; quota and budget are enforced centrally.
aiSettings.gatewayWhere: Where to configure key / grants / quota
aiSettings.gatewayWhereHint: {{brand}} portal → Admin console → AI Gateway (providers, grants, daily quota, platform budget)
aiSettings.gatewayFallback: Fallback: when no provider is available, the user is not authorized, quota is exhausted, or upstream fails, AI generation uses built-in templates and reports the fallback reason. The platform stores no upstream keys.

tplLib.title: Industry Template Library
tplLib.sub: Built-in industry HARA packs (steering/braking/cockpit/powertrain/ADAS…) — reference entries derived from public sources; all require engineering review. ASIL is computed live by the platform table
tplLib.hint: "Import selected" writes drafts into the project tagged with the source pack; after confirmation, one-click SG generation uses that domain wording

tq.title: Tool Qualification (TCL)
tq.sub: ISO 26262-8:2018 Cl.11 · Tool confidence determination & qualification measures
tq.name: Tool Name
tq.intendedUseHint: TCL is use-case bound: describe how the tool is used in the project
tq.intendedUsePh: e.g. manage SWE.1-3 requirements/architecture/detailed design & traceability
tq.needToolFirst: Register a tool first, then run the TCL assessment
tq.toolInUse: This tool has assessments; delete them first
tq.delAssess: Delete this assessment? Linked measures will be removed
tq.measureHint: Method suitability per Cl.11.4.6: VST validation / ICFU increased confidence from use / EDP evaluation of development process / DSS development per safety standard; preference by ASIL — TCL2: A/B/C favor ICFU·EDP, D favors VST; TCL3: A/B favor EDP·ICFU, C/D favor VST·DSS (per ISO 26262-8:2018 Table 5/6; exact ++/+ to be confirmed against the standard text)
tq.tiTip: TI1 = a malfunction cannot affect safety; TI2 = it may introduce/fail to detect safety-related errors
tq.tdTip: TD1 high / TD2 medium / TD3 low or none (confidence that tool errors are prevented or detected)

traceReport.title: Traceability Report
traceReport.desc: 从证据图谱汇总『需求 ↔ 设计 ↔ 单元 ↔ 测试 ↔ 风险』对应关系，生成静态、可签署报告。
traceReport.basisDesc: 依据 Automotive SPICE 3.1/4.0（SYS/SWE/SUP）与 ISO 26262：汇总 系统需求↔软件需求↔软件架构↔软件单元↔测试↔风险 的对应关系（V 模型双向追溯）。
traceReport.matrixTitle: 追溯矩阵（需求 {{cov}}/{{tot}} 已覆盖测试）
traceReport.matrixNote: 行=需求；列=设计/单元/测试/风险。「—」表示暂无对应关系（缺口）。
